
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/FatTiger4399/p/19226054" title="发布于 2025-11-15 18:52">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Golang游戏开发笔记:地图索引系统实现</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">好家伙,</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">在游戏开发，尤其是后端服务的构建过程中，我们常常从一个简单的想法或原型开始。</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">代码直接、功能明确，一切看起来都很好。但随着项目复杂度的提升，最初的“简洁”设计往往会变成“僵化”的枷锁。</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&nbsp;</span></strong></p>
<h1>0.需求分析</h1>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">我想我需要一张地图,作用如下:</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">1.记录所有人的位置,</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">2.快速的拿到某个角色的信息</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">3.快速拿到某个位置所有角色的信息</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">4.某个角色在释放技能时进行索敌,</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">&nbsp;</span></strong></p>
<h1>1.战场模型</h1>
<p><strong><span class="markdown-inline-code leading-[1.4]" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt"><span class="markdown-bold-text"><span class="markdown-bold-text">使用一个json文件来描述我们的战场</span></span></span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span>"mapId": "standard_24_lanes"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span>"name": "标准24格战场"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span>"positions"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
    { </span>"id": 0, "zone": "friendly", "lane": "back"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
    { </span>"id": 1, "zone": "friendly", "lane": "back"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
    { "id": 6, "zone": "friendly", "lane": "front"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
    { "id": 12, "zone": "enemy", "lane": "front"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
    { "id": 18, "zone": "enemy", "lane": "back"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ]
}</span></span></strong></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&nbsp;</span></strong></p>
<h1>2.建立战场数据模型</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="font-size: 14pt"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">p</span></span><span style="font-size: 14pt"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ackage</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> models

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> PositionLayout 定义了单个位置的静态属性</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">type</span> PositionLayout <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    ID   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>    `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
    Zone </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zone</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
    Lane </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lane</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> MapLayout 代表整个地图的静态布局</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">type</span> MapLayout <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    MapID       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>           `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mapId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
    Name        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>           `json:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
    Positions   []PositionLayout `json:</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">positions</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">`
}</span></span></span></strong></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&nbsp;</span></strong></p>
<h1>3.初始化战场代码</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> BattlePosition 代表战斗中一个位置的动态状态。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">type</span> BattlePosition <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    Layout   </span>*models.PositionLayout <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 引用静态布局信息</span>
    Fighters []*Fighter             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 存储当前站在此位置的战斗者</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Fight 管理两个战斗者之间的战斗状态。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">type</span> Fight <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    Team1        []</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Fighter
    Team2        []</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Fighter
    Log          strings.Builder
    DataLog      models.DataLog
    round        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    Battlefield  []</span>*BattlePosition   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Battlefield 是一个切片，索引直接对应位置ID</span>
    FightersByID <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">map</span>[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>]*Fighter <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新增一个用于快速查找的 map</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> NewFight 创建并初始化一个新的战斗实例。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">func</span> NewFight(team1Chars, team2Chars <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">map</span>[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>]models.Character, layout *models.MapLayout) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Fight {
    f :</span>= &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Fight{
        Team1:        []</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Fighter{},
        Team2:        []</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Fighter{},
        DataLog:      models.DataLog{Rounds: []models.Round{}},
        Battlefield:  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span>([]*BattlePosition, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">len</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(layout.Positions)),
        FightersByID: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">make</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">map</span>[<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>]*Fighter), <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化map</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 根据布局初始化战场</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> i, posLayout := <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">range</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> layout.Positions {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 复制一份，避免指针问题</span>
        layoutCopy :=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> posLayout
        f.Battlefield[i] </span>= &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">BattlePosition{
            Layout:   </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">layoutCopy,
            Fighters: []</span>*Fighter{}, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化为空</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 创建战斗者并放置到地图上</span>
    placeFighter := <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">func</span>(char models.Character, pos <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Fighter {
        charCopy :</span>= char <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建副本以确保每个fighter有自己的character实例</span>
        fighter := &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Fighter{
            Character: </span>&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">charCopy,
            CurrentHP: charCopy.Attributes.HP,
            Position:  pos,
            IsAlive:   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 将战斗者添加到对应位置的Fighters列表中</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> pos &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp;&amp; pos &lt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">len</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(f.Battlefield) {
            f.Battlefield[pos].Fighters </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">append</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(f.Battlefield[pos].Fighters, fighter)
        }
        f.FightersByID[charCopy.HeroID] </span>= fighter <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用HeroID作为key</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fighter
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> pos, char := <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">range</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> team1Chars {
        fighter :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> placeFighter(char, pos)
        f.Team1 </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">append</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(f.Team1, fighter)
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> pos, char := <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">range</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> team2Chars {
        fighter :</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> placeFighter(char, pos)
        f.Team2 </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">append</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(f.Team2, fighter)
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f
}</span></span></strong></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&nbsp;</span></strong></p>
<h1>4.分析</h1>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这么做会有两个显而易见的好处:高效与清晰的查询</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">针对两个需求,根据位置找人,或根据玩家id找人</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">对比我们的旧方法 :&nbsp;遍历所有角色，检查每个角色的&nbsp;Position&nbsp;字段是不是xx,遍历所有角色，检查每个角色的&nbsp;HeroID&nbsp;字段</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">而现在我们只需要</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt"><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接通过索引访问，就像查字典一样精准</span>
fightersAtPos := f.Battlefield[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Fighters

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接通过Key查找，一步到位</span>
fighter, found := f.FightersByID[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hero-111-111</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>]</span></strong></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">噢,这太棒了</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&nbsp;</span></strong></p>
<h1>5.补充:&nbsp;make()方法说明</h1>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt"><strong><span class="markdown-inline-code leading-[1.4]">make()&nbsp;是Go语言的一个内置函数，它的作用是<span class="markdown-bold-text">预先分配内存并初始化一个特定类型的对象，</span></span></strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt"><strong><span class="markdown-inline-code leading-[1.4]"><span class="markdown-bold-text">主要用于三种类型：<span class="markdown-bold-text">切片（slices）、映射（maps）和通道（channels）</span></span></span></strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt"><strong>make(...)作用:告诉go,请在内存中给我分配一块连续的空间,这个空间的长度要xxx</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<table class="markdown-table" align="left">
<thead>
<tr><th><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">代码</span></th><th><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">类型</span></th><th><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">作用</span></th><th><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">现实比喻</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span class="markdown-inline-code leading-[1.4]" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">make([]*BattlePosition, 24)</span></td>
<td><span class="markdown-bold-text" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">切片 (Slice)</span></td>
<td><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">创建一个有<span class="markdown-bold-text">24个空位的、<span class="markdown-bold-text">固定长度的列表。</span></span></span></td>
<td><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">建造一个有24个格子的空货架。</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span class="markdown-inline-code leading-[1.4]" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">make(map[string]*Fighter)</span></td>
<td><span class="markdown-bold-text" style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">映射 (Map)</span></td>
<td><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">创建一个<span class="markdown-bold-text">空的、<span class="markdown-bold-text">可动态增长的键值对存储结构。</span></span></span></td>
<td><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">准备一个空的、可以随时存取档案的档案柜。</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
